Import Previous Tracker
Load call history from your old Excel tracker (Sheet11). Rows without a valid DATE are skipped. Existing calls are preserved; duplicates by timestamp+account are skipped.
Google Sheets Sync
App Reset
Clears cached app data and forces the latest version to load. Your settings, promos, theme, goals, schedule, Sales ID, and Sheets connection are kept. Call history in Google Sheets is not affected.
No Sale Reasons
Edit categories and reasons. Drag to reorder. Click × to remove.
Internet Promotions
Speed tiers used by the 📜 Talk Track. Changes save automatically. Peacock years = 0 means the tier has no Peacock.

Known Bugs
#1
Layout width toggle breaks pill panel
When toggling layout width with the no-sale pill panel open, pills disappear and the panel renders empty. This feature has been removed — layout is now fixed at 720px.

Follow-Up Sales — Correct Credit Date In Progress
Callback sales will be credited to the date the callback was completed, not the original call date. XM line activations and revenue will flow to the correct fiscal month automatically.
